answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 12 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in delta, verified in tide, and copper names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and therefore paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 5 hours of verification and 21 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
